scope: Finite arithmetic only. If the supplied common-basis and coordinatewise precision claims are proved, CERTIFIED_DISTINCT proves the two true lines differ. INCONCLUSIVE does not prove equality.

source_bindings.analytic_leading_term: Toy definition in CERTIFICATE.md; exact vector (1,theta).
source_bindings.common_basis: The named formal basis of L^2 with theta^2=-1.
source_bindings.exceptional_line: Toy definition in CERTIFICATE.md; exact vector (1,theta+7).
source_bindings.precision: Both toy vectors are exact integer polynomials, hence accurate modulo 7^3.

unverified_mathematical_obligations: The stated analytic coefficient is the first nonzero coefficient of the true germ.
The exceptional vector represents the source-derived exceptional line in the same basis.
Both normalizations and coordinate error bounds are mathematically justified.
The global, Selmer, theta-order, and full-comparison hypotheses of README.md hold.
